name: National Pension Scheme for Traders
summary: For traders and the self-employed: join at age 18–40; assured pension of ₹3,000 a month from age 60.
description: Pension scheme for old-age protection and social security of shopkeepers, retail traders and self-employed persons.
targetBeneficiaries: Self-employed shop owners, retail owners and other vyaparis

criteria.label: Self-employed (shop owner, retail owner or other trader)

evidence.quote: For self employed shop owners, retail owners and other vyaparis

criteria.label: Annual business turnover does not exceed Rs 1.5 crore

evidence.quote: Annual turnover should not exceed Rs 1.5 crore

benefits.text: Assured pension of Rs. 3000 per month from age 60, with a matching contribution by the Government of India.

evidence.quote: National Pension Scheme provides assured 3000 monthly pension to Traders and Self - Employed persons at age of 60 years.

applicationProcess: Enrol through the Maandhan portal or at a Common Service Centre (CSC).

sources.title: MAANDHAN - National Pension Scheme for Traders
